consent.answer: Never. Every sale needs your explicit consent. You can decline any offer, and declining a pooled deal does not stop you from selling elsewhere.
consent.question: Can MandiMate sell my produce without asking me?

cost.answer: No. Farmers never pay to list, to join a pooled sale or to compare offers. Any cost that touches your sale — transport, handling, a market commission — is shown as its own line before you agree.
cost.question: Does it cost anything to list a harvest?

floor.answer: Only you, and a field coordinator if you choose to list with one. Buyers never see it. We use it to tell you which offers clear your floor once every cost is taken out.
floor.question: Who sees my minimum price?

rejection.answer: The quantity and reason are recorded at delivery with the inspector’s notes and photos. Rejections are traced to your own produce, not shared across the lot, and you can raise a dispute from the same screen.
rejection.question: What if some of my produce is rejected at delivery?

smartphone.answer: Yes. A field coordinator from your FPO or village cluster can list, explain offers and record your consent with you, in your language.
smartphone.question: I do not use a smartphone much. Can I still sell?

fees.answer: A coordination fee per successfully sourced lot, shown in your offer before you commit. There is no fee for posting requirements or browsing supply. Pilot pricing is subject to validation.

negotiate.answer: Yes. You can offer, counter and agree terms — price, quantity, quality standards, pickup and payment conditions — in one thread. Farmers in the lot consent before a deal is confirmed.

quality.answer: Lots are pooled only from produce that meets the specification you agreed — size, colour, defect tolerance. Produce is inspected at collection and again at delivery, and the results are recorded against each farmer’s share.

verification.answer: Field coordinators and FPO partners confirm farmers, quantities and readiness before a lot is offered. Supply is never invented or silently combined to fill an order.
verification.question: Who verifies the supply?

hero.footnote: No fee to post requirements. Pay a coordination fee only on lots you actually source.
